item.stem:
The diagram shows Aarna's square courtyard. Each side is marked $5\,\mathrm{m}$.

Which calculation gives its perimeter?

options.A: $4 \times 5 = 20\,\mathrm{m}$, because all four sides are equal.
options.B: Call the shape an equilateral triangle, and use $3 \times 5$.
options.C: Use $4 \times 5$ even if two sides were a different length.
options.D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$, taking the printed side length on the plan as the perimeter.
